Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_lov boolean;
 v_name varchar2(50);
BEGIN
 IF :control_block.site_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 if :control_block.drive_type = 'MOB' then
 SELECT distinct lc.location_id
 INTO :control_block.site_id
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :control_block.s_start_date
 AND (lc.location_id = :control_block.site_id
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I', 'C')
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 AND dr.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 AND lc.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 else
 SELECT distinct lc.location_id
 INTO :control_block.site_id
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :control_block.s_start_date
 AND (lc.location_id = :control_block.site_id
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.drive_type = decode(:control_block.drive_type, 'FIX', 'F', 'ALL', dr.drive_type)
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 AND dr.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 AND lc.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 end if;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('11103');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN others then
 if :control_block.drive_type = 'MOB' then
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_site');
 else
 v_lov := show_lov('lov_site_fix');
 end if; 
 IF NOT v_lov THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 v_time number;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT to_char(a.drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),a.location_id, 
 Initcap(b.location_name), b.site_directions, nvl(a.sch_travel_time, 0)
 INTO :pickup_schedule.drive_date, :pickup_schedule.site_id,:pickup_schedule.site_name,
 :pickup_schedule.directions, :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time
 FROM drives a, locations b
 WHERE a.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id
 AND a.location_id = b.location_id
 AND b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time; 
 end if;
 --End If;
 End; 
 
 v_time := :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time;
 IF v_time = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(travel_time, 0)
 INTO v_time
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = :pickup_schedule.site_id

 /** select driver name from employees **/

 IF :pickup_schedule.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT Initcap(vehicle_name)
 INTO :pickup_schedule.vehicle_name
 FROM valid_vehicles
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND vehicle_type = 'PIKUP'
 AND vehicle_id = :pickup_schedule.vehicle_id
 AND rownum =1 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 END IF;
 do_retrieve_start_time;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_START_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_start_time IS
 v_travel_time number;
 h_arrival_time date;
 v_date date;
 v_pickuptime date;
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 v_local_time1 date;
BEGIN
IF :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time != 0 THEN
 SELECT (p.pick_up_time - (nvl(sch_travel_time,0)/(60*24))) pick
 INTO v_date
 FROM drives dr, pickup_schedule p
 WHERE dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND p.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id
 AND p.pickup_id = :pickup_schedule.pickup_id
 -- AND drive_date = :pickup_schedule.drive_date
 AND status = 'CNFRM';
 
 
ELSIF :pickup_schedule.sch_travel_time =0 THEN 
 SELECT (p.pick_up_time - (nvl(travel_time,60)/(60*24)))pick
 INTO v_date
 FROM locations l, drives dr, pickup_schedule p
 WHERE l.location_id = dr.location_id
 AND l.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND p.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND p.pickup_id = :pickup_schedule.pickup_id
 -- AND drive_date = :pickup_schedule.drive_date
 AND status = 'CNFRM'
 AND p.drive_id = :pickup_schedule.drive_id;
 
END IF;
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for schedule_state_time*/

 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date,v_local_time);
 
 
 :pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_local_time, 'HH24:MI');
 
 else
 :pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_date, 'HH24:MI');
 --:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time;
 
 end if;
 
 --:pickup_schedule.start_time := to_char(v_date, 'HH24:MI');
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHANGE_COLOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE change_color IS
 v_current varchar2(20);
 v_pickup varchar2(20);
 v_date_minus date;
 v_date_minus_change varchar2(20);
 v_date_add date;
 v_date_add_change varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 v_current := to_char(sysdate, 'HH24MI');
 v_date_minus := sysdate - 60/(60*24);
 v_date_minus_change := to_char(v_date_minus, 'HH24MI');
 v_date_add := sysdate + 120/(60*24);
 v_date_add_change := to_char(v_date_add, 'HH24MI');
 v_pickup := to_char(:pickup_schedule.pick_up_time, 'HH24MI'); 
go_block('pickup_schedule');
 first_record;
loop
 if :pickup_schedule.dispatch_time is null THEN
 if :pickup_schedule.pick_up_time < sysdate
 THEN
 display_item('pickup_schedule.dispatch_time_am', 'va_red');
 elsif :pickup_schedule.pick_up_time between sysdate and v_date_add THEN
 -- AND v_pickup > v_date_add_change THEN
 display_item('pickup_schedule.dispatch_time_am', 'va_yellow');
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' THEN
 exit;
 END IF;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_FIX
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.drive_id, c.name from drives a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c where c.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and a.drive_id = b.drive_id and a.status = 'CNFRM' and (c.name like decode(:control_block.drive_id,null,'%','%'||:control_block.drive_id||'%') 
or a.drive_id = nvl(:control_block.drive_id, a.drive_id))
and a.drive_date = :control_block.s_start_date
and a.location_id = nvl(:control_block.site_id, a.location_id) 
and a.drive_type = decode(:control_block.drive_type, 'FIX', 'F', 'ALL', a.drive_type)
and a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
order by 2

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SITE_FIX
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT lc.location_id, lc.location_name
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND (lc.location_id =nvl( :control_block.site_id, lc.location_id)
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.drive_date = nvl(:control_block.s_start_date, dr.drive_date)
 AND dr.drive_type = decode(:control_block.drive_type, 'FIX', 'F', 'ALL', dr.drive_type) 
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 and dr.chapter_id = lc.chapter_id
 and dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SITE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT lc.location_id, lc.location_name
 FROM locations lc, drives dr
 WHERE sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)
 AND dr.location_id = lc.location_id
 AND (lc.location_id =nvl( :control_block.site_id, lc.location_id)
 OR lc.location_name like '%'||:control_block.site_id||'%')
 AND dr.drive_date = nvl(:control_block.s_start_date, dr.drive_date)
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I', 'C')
 AND dr.status = 'CNFRM'
 and lc.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
